items.title: 'Miracle on Mississippi' - All passengers rescued after New Orleans cruise ship collision
items.description: The collision leaves 32 people in hospital with non-critical injuries, but no-one unaccounted for.

items.title: Microsoft 'deeply sorry' for global outage after almost 24 hours of disruption
items.description: Experts say the event is a "stark reminder" of how heavily the world relies on a small group of big tech providers.

items.title: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?
items.description: Microsoft says it is continuing to restore services including Outlook and Teams following a global outage.

items.title: Watch: How a server outage took down Microsoft Teams and Outlook
items.description: A Microsoft outage is affecting services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot.

items.title: Setback for SpaceX Starship rocket's double-catch test
items.description: Elon Musk’s company aborted an attempted catch of the rocket’s booster - instead it came down in the ocean.

items.title: Rosenberg: Uncompromising Putin ups demands for peace with Ukraine
items.description: The fact the question of European security now features in discussions is viewed in Moscow as a victory, BBC Russia Editor Steve Rosenberg says.

items.title: Nvidia scandal fallout widens as Trump's treasury secretary blames cabinet colleague
items.description: Scott Bessent suggests Howard Lutnick’s commerce department failed to ban exports of Nvidia's chips to a firm thought to have links with China.

items.title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own
items.description: Pope Leo XIV is in Peru as part of his Latin America tour, just weeks after having surgery for lung cancer.

items.title: German spies handed new powers to tackle 'hybrid threats' from abroad
items.description: German reforms mean foreign and domestic intelligence services will have greater powers to combat espionage, terrorism and sabotage.

items.title: Democratic Senate leader Schumer set to face leadership challenge
items.description: Maryland Senator Van Hollen says "new leadership" is needed for Democrats following the party's recent midterm successes.

items.title: Aide to fugitive Ukrainian ex-PM wounded in latest Moscow car bombing
items.description: Sergei Zavorotny, now a journalist and commentator, was previously an adviser to Ukrainian ex-prime minister Mykola Azarov.

items.title: Rosalía scoops historic third best album award at Latin Grammys
items.description: The Spanish singer is recognised for her fourth album Lux which was released last year to rave reviews.
